name: William Hope Spirit Photograph #1
description: A 1919 'spirit photograph' by William Hope, a photographer associated with staged paranormal images. It supposedly shows a deceased son appearing with his parents.

name: William Hope Spirit Photograph #4
description: An alleged spirit photograph showing Hortense Leverson with an apparition said to be her deceased husband.

name: Marshal Haig Funeral Spirit Photograph
description: An alleged spirit photograph from Marshal Douglas Haig's funeral. The image has been suspected of being a double exposure.

name: Mrs Longcake Spirit Photograph
description: A William Hope photograph purportedly showing Mrs Longcake alongside the spirit of her deceased sister-in-law.

name: Society for Supernormal Pictures
description: A photograph from a meeting of the Society for the Study of Supernormal Pictures, with a supposed spirit appearing in front of the group.

name: Charles Foster Spirit Photograph
description: An alleged spirit photograph of medium Charles Foster, reproduced in an 1884 book on spiritualism.

name: Dog Spirit Photograph
description: A historical image presented as an alleged spirit photograph of a dog.

name: Fake Spirit Photograph Example
description: An 1897 example demonstrating a fake spirit photograph from Henry Ridgely Evans' writing on nineteenth-century ghost tricks.

name: William Barrett Spirit Photograph
description: Psychical researchers William F. Barrett and Stanley De Brath in an alleged spirit photograph taken by William Hope.

name: Stainton Moses Spirit Photograph
description: An alleged spirit photograph featuring medium William Stainton Moses, published in 1882.
